lessons.trigger_condition: Incomplete Job results, unverified Query evidence, altered image split metadata, announcement dates and shortened Retry-After could cross trusted boundaries.
lessons.prevention_rule: Require exact typed terminal outcomes, matching observation evidence, revalidated image receipts, event-date context and original provider waits; preserve valid history and isolate invalid rows.
validation_required: Invalid input and actual completed-outcome regressions, native receipt integrity, date provenance, long Retry-After, exact historical and descendant source lineage
lessons.safety_boundary: No invented labels, weakened source pins, cloud learning, live grading auto-enable or physical-device claims.
